description: Script to pack EC binary with manifest header, used for creating firmware images with specific binary layout and headers for the Intel ISH environment.

methods.name: parseargs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for kernel, aon, and output files.

methods.name: gen_manifest
methods.description: Creates a binary manifest entry with specified identifiers, offset, and size.

methods.name: roundup_page
methods.description: Calculates the page size rounded up to the nearest PAGE_SIZE multiple.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that packs the firmware images with headers and manifests.
